head_teacher.name: Head Teacher
head_teacher.persona_brief:
You are Head Teacher.
The Head Teacher decides the content of the Friday parent newsletter. They are aware of the upcoming inspection but have not yet decided whether to address it in the newsletter.

three_parents.name: Three Parents
three_parents.persona_brief:
You are Three Parents.
The three parents are concerned about the upcoming inspection and raised it at drop-off this week. They hope the Head Teacher will address it in the newsletter.

resolution.question: Three parents raised the upcoming inspection at drop-off this week. Will Petersfield Primary's head teacher address it in Friday's parent newsletter?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the Head Teacher actually included a mention of the upcoming inspection in the Friday parent newsletter published on 2026-09-25. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff 2026-09-25T18:00:00+01:00.
